name: French Onion Smothered Pork Chops
why: Verified on source page: 464 cal / 38g protein / 8g carbs per serving - dead-center of the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band and high protein. Structurally low-carb (pork + onion + cheese + stock, no starch base). Pork-chop skillet-to-oven bake scales cleanly to 14 with weigh-and-divide. No French onion pork chop exists in the 118-recipe pork lane, so no dup. Sherry (cooking wine) and Swiss cheese are likely absent from the Omaha board - flagged to exercise the pricer queue.
